description: Resolve a place name to a place id, or list the places containing a map area. Pass q to match a place-name PREFIX, or all four of nelat, nelng, swlat and swlng to list every place covering that box — exactly one of the two, never both. Each result carries the bounding box, place type, and containment chain an area search needs. Place geometry is stripped: a single nearby response carries 247 KB of boundary polygons upstream, none of which reaches the caller.

nelat.description: North-east corner latitude of the map area, at or north of swlat. All four corners or none.

nelng.description: North-east corner longitude of the map area. All four corners or none. West of swlng is accepted: it describes a box crossing the antimeridian.

per_page.description: Maximum places per list. Honoured on the bounding-box arm only, where it bounds the standard and community lists separately, so up to twice this many places come back. The name-prefix endpoint publishes no page size and returns a fixed page.

q.description: Place-name prefix to search. Matches the start of a name, not words inside it. Mutually exclusive with the bounding box.

swlat.description: South-west corner latitude of the map area. All four corners or none.

swlng.description: South-west corner longitude of the map area. All four corners or none.

name: inaturalist_find_places

cap.description: The most places this response could carry — per_page × 2 on the bounding-box arm, where per_page bounds each list separately; the fixed page upstream served on the name-prefix arm.

community.description: Member-created places covering the area. Present on the bounding-box arm.

items.description: One place, with the bounding box and containment chain an area search needs.

admin_level.description: Raw administrative-level integer. No published code table; often null.

ancestor_place_ids.description: Containment chain, outermost first. Empty when upstream records none.

bbox.description: Corner pair computed from the place’s bounding polygon, ready to pass as a bounding box. Relayed as computed: a place crossing the antimeridian genuinely has a degenerate box upstream and it is not repaired here.

display_name.description: Place name with its administrative context, e.g. "Seattle CCD, US, WA".

id.description: Place id — pass it as place_id to any area-scoped tool.

name.description: Place name as iNaturalist records it.

place_type.description: Raw place-type integer. iNaturalist publishes no code table for it, so no label is invented — display_name carries the meaning.

slug.description: URL slug. The place record publishes no URL of its own.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_geography`: Neither q nor a complete bounding box was given, both were, or the box has nelat south of swlat. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, or when the page capped the result set.

places.description: Name-prefix matches. Present on the q arm.

truncated.description: True when more places may exist than were returned — on the bounding-box arm, when the standard or community list reached per_page.
